'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Nicholas Tobin LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nicholas Tobin]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Rogues Never Die. Nicholas Tobin / NinjaElf6, 2014 Worlds Day 2 8/23/14, 2013 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' NinjaElf6
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
